The '''new Umboo Lightstation''' was a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] operated by [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] [[Bisad Koong|Koong]] of [[Roon/Legends|Roon's]] [[Tawntoom]] province.

==History==
After Koong closed the original [[Umboo lightstation|Umboo Lightstation]], he used the ship's lights to lure unsuspecting vessels towards it, bringing them aboard with a [[Tractor beam/Legends|tractor beam]] and seizing their cargo. In [[15 BBY/Legends|15 BBY]], [[Mungo Baobab]] was brought aboard on his ship, the ''[[Caravel (starship)|Caravel]]'', but the merchant was able to escape his captivity and the new Umboo Lightstation was destroyed when its engines were damaged and it collided with an [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]].
